judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale:
The link's real accessible name is not '1 min'. The wraps plus the duration

1 min

. No aria-hidden or role=presentation is set, and the image is rendered: the snapshot's readingText for the cover div includes the alt, and the screenshot shows the thumbnail. Under accname, a link's name from content includes a child img's alt. So browsers and screen readers announce 'Lago na Turquia tem minerais iguais aos de antigo lago em Marte - Programa: G1 Ciência e Saúde 1 min'. That names the destination, whose title is 'Vídeo: Lago na Turquia tem minerais...'. The snapshot recorded '1 min' because the collector's accessibleName (src/surfaces/in-page.ts:208) uses el.textContent, which drops img alt. Even with a bare '1 min', the claim that nothing around it helps is false. The same feed-post card has an h2 just before it holding a link with the same href and the text 'Lago na Turquia tem minerais iguais aos de antigo lago em Marte' (H80 context). The suggested patch also drops the image's text alternative.
